sections.label: Internet transactions with local and foreign entities
sections.summary: Over three years, local-entity Internet transactions totalled about $18.3 billion, around 74% of Internet transactions, while foreign-entity transactions were $6.4 billion.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry))
sentences.text: Over the past three years, the total value of such transactions with local entities was about $18.3 billion, representing around 74% of total Internet transactions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry))
sentences.text: Internet transactions with foreign entities amounted to $6.4 billion.

sections.label: Retail Industry Transformation Map e-commerce target
sections.summary: The Retail Industry Transformation Map launched in September 2016 aims to grow e-commerce share of total retail receipts to 10% by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry))
sentences.text: Under the Retail Industry Transformation Map (ITM) launched in September 2016, we aim to grow the e-commerce share of total retail receipts to 10% by 2020.

sections.label: E-commerce share in China, UK, US
sections.summary: In 2014, studies indicated e-commerce accounted for about 10%, 13% and 6.5% of total retail sales in China, the UK and the US.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: If we want to make a comparison, in 2014, based on studies, we understand that e-commerce accounted for about 10%, 13% and 6.5% of total retail sales in China, the UK and the US respectively.

sections.label: Retail ITM aims and retailer programmes
sections.summary: Under the retail ITM, the intention is to foster a vibrant retail scene, see strong local brand owners with global footprints, and strengthen Singapore-based retailers' competitiveness through programmes and strategies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: As I mentioned earlier, under our retail ITM, our intention is to help foster a very vibrant Singapore retail scene and we want to see strong local brand owners with global footprints.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: In terms of strengthening the competitiveness of Singapore-based retailers' Singapore brands, vis-Ã-vis their global competitors, that is certainly a very important thrust of our work under the retail ITM.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: So, to this end, we have various programmes and strategies in place to help our retailers improve their capabilities.

sections.label: Tracking and publishing retail sales data
sections.summary: A question asks whether the Ministry will regularly track and publish retail and e-commerce sales data, and the reply says such studies and figures are available and tracked for benchmarking.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Just a question to the Senior Minister of State: will the Ministry consider tracking and publishing retail sales and e-commerce sales data regularly – as the Senior Minister of State has alluded to, it is being done in the US and China – in the future since this may be very important for stakeholders to understand?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: As I have mentioned, I believe that quite a number of such studies and figures are available being done by different organisations.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: These are all figures that we track because we do want to benchmark ourselves against the retail scene in different countries and to see where we stand.
